answer_1.quote: This paper is the first to study how to rewrite inappropriate arguments automatically.
answer_1.outputs: rewritten arguments that are more appropriate while preserving semantic similarity to the original

answer_2.quote: We employ the five appropriateness classifiers of  trained on different folds of the data. As we use the entire appropriateness corpus for evaluation, we ensure the use of the classifier for each argument that has not seen the argument before as part of its training.

answer_4.quote: We again hire native English speakers on Upwork.com (7 female and 8 male) to evaluate the rewrites in absolute and relative terms, such that each rewrite (pair) is evaluated by five annotators.
answer_4.guideline: In the first study, the annotators scored each rewrite regarding three considered quality metrics: App. Appropriateneess of the topic discussion in terms of style and content; Sim. Meaning preservation of the original arguments; Flu. Fluency and adherence to grammar conventions.
